title: Specialised Areas
outcomes: Audit statements under special purpose frameworks.
Audit single statements and specific elements.
Choose reporting features across specialised engagements.

meta.exam_tip: Match the request to SA 800, 805 or 810 first.

concepts.title: Special purpose frameworks (SA 800)
body: A special purpose framework is designed to meet the information needs of specific users — e.g. tax basis, cash basis, regulator's provisions, contract-based reporting. SA 800 adapts other SAs for such audits.

The auditor understands the purpose, intended users and steps taken by management to choose the framework, and confirms it is acceptable. Interpretation of contract terms used as a basis must be described.

The report describes the purpose and, where appropriate, includes an emphasis of matter alerting users that the statements are prepared under a special purpose framework and may not suit other purposes; distribution or use may be restricted.
concepts.analogy: Special frameworks need users told what the statements are — and are not — for.
concepts.work: Statements prepared to meet a loan agreement's definitions follow SA 800.

concepts.title: Single statements and specific elements (SA 805)
body: SA 805 covers audits of a single statement (e.g. balance sheet only) or a specific element, account or item (e.g. receivables, royalty payable, provision for income tax). All relevant SAs apply, adapted to the engagement.
Materiality is set for the single statement or element; interrelated items must be considered (e.g. sales when auditing receivables). The auditor may need to audit more than the element alone.

If the opinion on the complete statements is adverse or a disclaimer, the auditor does not include an unmodified opinion on an element in the same report; a separate report on the element may be issued only if it is not a major portion of the statements and the law permits.
concepts.analogy: Auditing one item still needs the context of the whole.
concepts.work: An opinion on royalties payable requires understanding sales figures used.

concepts.title: Summary financial statements (SA 810)
body: SA 810 covers reporting on summary (abridged) financial statements derived from audited statements by the same auditor. Using the applied criteria, the auditor judges whether the summary agrees in every material way with the audited statements.

Procedures: compare summary with audited statements, evaluate adequacy of disclosure of the summarised nature, check that audited statements are available to users, and ensure the summary report is dated no earlier than the audited report.
If the audited report is modified, the summary report states this; if adverse or disclaimer, the auditor withholds an opinion on the summary.
concepts.analogy: Summary statements can only be as good as the audited set.
concepts.work: Abridged statements sent to shareholders need consistency with audited accounts.

concepts.title: Reporting choices across specialised engagements
body: Each specialised engagement uses tailored reports: identifying the framework or criteria, purpose, users and responsibilities.
Restrictions on distribution or use, emphasis of matter on the basis of preparation, and other matter paragraphs are common features.
Engagement acceptance requires agreeing terms (SA 210) and confirming the framework's acceptability and the auditor's ability to obtain evidence.
concepts.analogy: Tailor the report to the user and the framework.
concepts.work: A cash-basis statement for a charity donor includes a restricted-use note.

illustrations.title: Auditing a single schedule
illustrations.q: A lender asks the auditor of Ivy Ltd. to give an opinion only on its schedule of trade receivables of ₹250 lakh. The auditor also audits Ivy's complete statements, which carry a qualified opinion on inventory. The auditor sets materiality for the schedule at 1% of its value. Explain the approach.

head: Point
Treatment
rows: SA 805 — specific element of a financial statement
Consider interrelated items (sales, allowance for credit loss)
Consider relevance; qualified inventory issue may not affect receivables
Separate report on the schedule, distinguishable from the main report
solution.title: SA 805

checks.label: Materiality for the receivables schedule at 1% (₹ lakh)

illustrations.title: Reporting on summary statements
illustrations.q: An auditor is asked to report on abridged financial statements of a company whose audited statements carry (a) an unmodified opinion; (b) a qualified opinion; (c) an adverse opinion. What opinion can be given on the summary statements?

head: Audited opinion
Summary report under SA 810
rows: Unmodified opinion that summary is consistent with audited statements
Unmodified on consistency, but describe the qualified opinion and its basis and effect
Withhold an opinion on the summary statements
solution.title: SA 810

jobs.title: Lender-specific audit request
jobs.situation: A bank needs audited statements under the loan agreement's accounting rules.
steps: Confirm the framework's acceptability and users.
Issue a report with basis-of-preparation EOM and restriction.
jobs.takeaway: Know the user, the framework and the limits on use.

mcqs.q: Statements prepared on a tax basis for filing with tax authorities follow:
options: A special purpose framework under SA 800
mcqs.explain: Specific users. In practice: EOM on basis.

mcqs.q: An audit of only the schedule of receivables falls under:
mcqs.explain: Specific element. In practice: element materiality.

mcqs.q: Abridged financial statements are reported on under:
mcqs.explain: Summary statements. In practice: consistency opinion.

mcqs.q: If audited statements carry an adverse opinion, the auditor reporting on summary statements:
In SA 805 engagements, materiality is determined for:
mcqs.explain: Element-level. In practice: may be lower.

options: An emphasis of matter on the basis of preparation
mcqs.explain: Alerts users. In practice: may restrict use.

mcqs.q: The summary report under SA 810 cannot be dated:
options: Earlier than the audited statements' report
mcqs.explain: Consistency in time. In practice: same or later date.

mcqs.q: Before accepting any specialised engagement, the auditor must:
options: Confirm the framework is acceptable and agree terms
mcqs.explain: SA 210 preconditions. In practice: written terms.

Treatment

questions.q: An auditor is asked to report on abridged financial statements of a company whose audited statements carry (a) an unmodified opinion; (b) a qualified opinion; (c) an adverse opinion. What opinion can be given on the summary statements?

head: Audited opinion
Summary report under SA 810
rows: Unmodified opinion that summary is consistent with audited statements
Unmodified on consistency, but describe the qualified opinion and its basis and effect
Withhold an opinion on the summary statements
model.title: SA 810

mistakes: Giving an opinion despite adverse audit report.

summary: EOM on basis; restriction on use.
traps: Giving an unmodified summary opinion after an adverse audit opinion.

viva.q: What is a special purpose framework?
viva.model: A reporting basis built for particular users' needs rather than general users, such as a tax or contractual basis.

viva.q: Why must interrelated items be considered under SA 805?
viva.model: Because an element is affected by related accounts, so evidence on them is needed for a sound opinion.

viva.q: What opinion is expressed under SA 810?
viva.model: Whether, judged against materiality, the summary agrees with the audited statements under the applied criteria.

viva.q: When can a separate SA 805 report be given if the main opinion is adverse?
viva.model: Only if the element forms a minor part of the statements, law permits it, and the opinion sits in a separate report.

viva.q: What features are common in specialised reports?
viva.model: Description of purpose and users, emphasis of matter on basis of preparation, and restriction on use.

cases.title: Stellar Retail Ltd.
cases.case: Stellar Retail's main audit report contains a disclaimer of opinion. The company asks its auditor to (a) report on its abridged statements for a newspaper, and (b) give an opinion on its schedule of rent payable, which is 2% of total expenses.

mcqs.q: On the abridged statements, the auditor should:
mcqs.explain: Disclaimer on audited set. In practice: SA 810.

mcqs.q: The rent schedule engagement falls under:
mcqs.explain: Specific element. In practice: separate report.

mcqs.q: An unmodified opinion on rent payable can be given:
options: Only in a separate report, as rent is not a major portion and if law permits
In the same report as the disclaimer
mcqs.explain: SA 805 restriction. In practice: assess carefully.

mcqs.q: Before acceptance, the auditor must confirm:
options: Acceptability of the criteria and terms
mcqs.explain: SA 210. In practice: written engagement letter.
